event.description: Replace the learned rank-8-to-14 positional projection with a fixed orthogonal DCT basis while retaining the 35x8 learned positional code table and all retained attention/feed-forward settings.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0012, learned positional rank 8 (3430, 99.66%); the most recent failed result is the attempt-0013 rank-descending automation, whose rank-6 micro-trial was an optimization failure with 10.25% peak validation; 3 prior family macro-attempts. The immediately preceding no-offset normalization attempt-0016 is an optimization failure (30000 steps, 10.25% peak validation, no checkpoint), not an official nonqualification. Hypothesis: the learned per-position rank-8 codes may encode the needed fixed-format role information even if their expansion basis is deterministic; a fixed orthogonal DCT projection removes 112 learned weights while keeping all 35 position-specific codes, reducing 3430 to 3318 parameters. This is a representational factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested learned rank-7 alternative because it separates the need for a learned positional subspace orientation from the independently observed rank capacity boundary.
